statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (G45.9, Z86.73)
The monitoring is required to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with the patient's symptoms
The correlation is needed to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered
